# China Fulfillment International

> Shenzhen-based 3PL and ecommerce fulfilment warehouse, founded in 2010. We receive goods from Chinese factories, check and prep them, store them, and ship orders to customers in 200+ countries or into Amazon FBA. Services cover D2C ecommerce fulfilment (Shopify, WooCommerce, TikTok Shop), Kickstarter and Indiegogo reward fulfilment, Amazon FBA prep and consolidation, quality control, supplier management by a Mandarin-speaking team, and freight forwarding with DDP shipping.

Key facts (published on our site; checked 3 October 2026):

- Legal entity: China Fulfillment International is the trading name of PFC Express Ltd. Vehicles and some documents carry the PFC Express name.
- Founded 2010 in Longhua, Shenzhen, by Noel Murphy and Ouyang Ke. About 140 staff. 250,000 sq ft of warehouse space. Around 300,000 parcels a month.
- Office: 3rd Floor, Building D, Minle Industrial Park, Meiban Road, Longhua, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China.
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm, Saturday and Sunday 10am to 2pm, Beijing time (GMT+8). Quotes within 24 hours. Email: support@china-fulfillment.com.
- Typical delivery times from Shenzhen: 6 to 10 days to the US, 5 to 8 days to the UK, 6 to 14 days to the EU.
- Holds an AAAA Logistics Enterprise rating in China.

Published prices in USD (checked 3 October 2026; see the pricing page for the current list):

- Pick and pack: $0.99 per order for D2C orders, branded packaging included. $0.99 per carton for Amazon FBA prep.
- Storage: $0.49 per CBM per day. The first 30 days are free for new customers.
- Receiving: free, from any number of suppliers.
- FNSKU labelling from $0.15 per unit. Poly bagging from $0.30 per unit. Bubble wrap from $0.30 per unit. Kitting and bundling from $0.50 per unit.
- Standard visual quality inspection: free.
- No setup fees, account fees, minimum volumes or lock-in contracts.
- Shipping is quoted per shipment by weight, size, destination and service (express, air, sea, DDP lines).

What we do not do: we are not the importer of record by default. Import duties, VAT or GST registration (for example IOSS or UK VAT), customs bonds, and product compliance such as FDA, MoCRA, FSVP, CPC or dangerous-goods certification remain the responsibility of the seller or manufacturer. On DDP shipments the duty is paid within the shipping price, but the legal obligations still sit with the seller or their appointed importer. Our guides explain who owns each obligation.

## Services

- [D2C eCommerce Fulfillment](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/ecommerce-fulfillment.html): Shopify, WooCommerce and marketplace orders picked, packed in branded packaging and shipped from Shenzhen.
- [Crowdfunding Fulfillment](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/china-crowdfunding-fulfillment.html): Kickstarter and Indiegogo backer rewards, kitting and DDP to 200+ countries.
- [Amazon FBA Prep](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/amazon-fba-prep-china.html): FNSKU labelling, poly bagging, bundling and carton prep in Shenzhen, since Amazon stopped prep on 1 January 2026.
- [Amazon FBA Consolidation](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/amazon-fba-consolidation.html): store stock in Shenzhen and send smaller, regular replenishments to Amazon.
- [D2C Brand Consolidation](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/china-consolidation.html): one address for all your Chinese suppliers, combined into consolidated shipments.
- [Quality Control and FBA Prep](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/quality-control-fba-prep-china.html): inspection against your spec before goods leave China.
- [Supplier Management](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/supplier-management-china.html): production tracking, arrival checks and supplier disputes handled in Mandarin.
- [Branded Packaging and Kitting](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/branded-packaging-kitting.html): custom packaging from 50 pieces and kit assembly.
- [Multi-Channel Fulfillment](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/multi-channel-fulfillment-china.html): one inventory pool for Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon and crowdfunding orders.
- [Freight Forwarding](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/international-freight-forwarding-china.html): sea, air and express from Shenzhen, including to Amazon FBA.
- [Express Shipping](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/express-international-shipping-china.html): DHL, FedEx and UPS from Shenzhen.
- [Tariff Management and DDP](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/tariff-management-china.html): HTS classification support and customs documentation.
- [Cash on Delivery](https://www.china-fulfillment.com/cod-service.html): COD fulfilment to Southeast Asia and the Middle East.
